# Waldorf Curriculum

> > A comprehensive resource for Waldorf/Steiner homeschool curriculum, lesson plans, and educational materials from early childhood through eighth grade.

This site provides free curriculum resources, lesson plans, and teaching materials following the Waldorf/Steiner educational philosophy. It includes grade-specific content, getting started guides for homeschoolers, and references to key Waldorf organizations like AWSNA and the Research Institute for Waldorf Education.

## Key Topics

- Waldorf Education
- Steiner Education
- Waldorf Method
- Homeschool Curriculum
- Early Childhood Education
- Play-Based Kindergarten
- AWSNA (Association of Waldorf Schools of North America)
- Research Institute for Waldorf Education
- Lower Grades Curriculum
- Form Drawing
- Morning Verse
- Waldorf Early Childhood Association
- Lesson Plans
- Religious Education
- Curriculum Resources

## Getting Started with Waldorf Homeschooling

- [Getting Started Guide](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/GettingStarted/heather.html): Getting started guide for Waldorf homeschool and early childhood education
- [Getting Started - Library Resources](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/GettingStarted/heather_library.html): Getting started with Waldorf homeschool library and early childhood resources
- [Getting Started - Art and Play](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/GettingStarted/heather_art.html): Getting started with Waldorf kindergarten art and play-based learning

## Lower Grades Curriculum (Grades 1-2)

- [First Grade Curriculum Overview](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Lower%20grades/1st_overview.html): First grade curriculum overview for Waldorf/Steiner homeschool
- [Second Grade - Animal Fables](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Class2/fables.html): Second grade animal fables and Aesop's Fables language arts curriculum
- [Second Grade - Native American Legends](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Class2/namer.html): Second grade Native American legends lesson plans for Waldorf curriculum
- [Second Grade - Stories of the Saints](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Class2/saints.html): Second grade saints stories curriculum for Waldorf religious education

## Middle Grades Curriculum (Grades 5-8)

- [Fifth Grade - Botany I & II](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Class5/botany.html): Fifth grade botany curriculum for Waldorf science education
- [Eighth Grade - Short Stories](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Class8/short_stories.html): Eighth grade short stories curriculum for Waldorf/Steiner education

## Curriculum Resources and References

- [Miscellaneous Additional Resources](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Curric/misc.html): Additional resources for Waldorf/Steiner homeschool curriculum materials
- [Morning Verse for Lower Grades](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Curric/verselower.html): Morning verse resources for Waldorf lower grades and elementary education
- [Form Drawing for Better Handwriting](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Curric/01/FD_handwriting.html): Form drawing techniques for improving handwriting in Waldorf education

## Early Childhood and Preschool

- [Preschool Families Unit Booklist](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Preschool/Families/familiesbooklist.html): Preschool families unit booklist for Waldorf early childhood (ages 3-4)

- [Waldorf Clearing House Newsletter](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/Index%20page/waldorf_newsletter.html): Newsletter from Waldorf Clearing House with free curriculum resources

- [Contact and Consulting](https://waldorfcurriculum.com/new_website/contact.html): Contact page for Waldorf curriculum consulting and educational services
